orig.zht: 評曰：太祖建茲武功，而時之良將，五子為先。
orig.zhs: 评曰：太祖建兹武功，而时之良将，五子为先。

vern.zht: 陳壽評論道：太祖曹操建立如此輝煌的武功，而當時的良將，以這五位爲首。
vern.zhs: 陈寿评论道：太祖曹操建立如此辉煌的武功，而当时的良将，以这五位为首。

passages.en: Chen Shou appraises: Cao Cao achieved such brilliant military accomplishments, and among the able generals of the time, these five stood foremost.

vern.zht: [[于禁|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17c]]最爲剛毅穩重，但沒能保持有始有終。
vern.zhs: [[于禁|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17c]]最为刚毅稳重，但没能保持有始有终。

passages.en: [[Yu Jin|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17c]] was especially renowned for firmness and solemnity, yet he failed to maintain these qualities to the end.

orig.zht: [[張郃|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17d]]以巧變為稱，[[樂進|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17b]]以驍果顯名，而鑒其行事，未副所聞。
orig.zhs: [[张郃|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17d]]以巧变为称，[[乐进|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17b]]以骁果显名，而鉴其行事，未副所闻。

vern.zht: [[張郃|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17d]]以機智靈活著稱，[[樂進|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17b]]以驍勇果敢聞名，但觀覽他們的事蹟，與所聽到的名聲並不相稱。
vern.zhs: [[张郃|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17d]]以机智灵活著称，[[乐进|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17b]]以骁勇果敢闻名，但观览他们的事迹，与所听到的名声并不相称。

passages.en: [[Zhang He|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17d]] was celebrated for his resourcefulness and adaptability, while [[Yue Jin|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17b]] was famed for his valour and decisiveness. Yet when one examines the deeds recorded of them, they do not seem to fully match their reputations.

orig.zht: 或注記有遺漏，未如[[張遼|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17a]]、[[徐晃|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17e]]之備詳也。
orig.zhs: 或注记有遗漏，未如[[张辽|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17a]]、[[徐晃|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17e]]之备详也。

vern.zht: 也許是生平事蹟記載有遺漏，不如[[張遼|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17a]]、[[徐晃|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17e]]那樣完備詳細吧。
vern.zhs: 也许是生平事迹记载有遗漏，不如[[张辽|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17a]]、[[徐晃|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17e]]那样完备详细吧。

passages.en: Perhaps some details of their lives were missing from the records, which were therefore not as full and detailed as those of [[Zhang Liao|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17a]] and [[Xu Huang|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-17e]].
